title: Research Engineer – Generative AI and Computer Vision
description: Role Overview The Research Engineer – Generative AI and Computer Vision focuses on advancing state-of-the-art Generative AI and deep learning methods for real-world computer vision applications. The role combines applied research, experimentation, and engineering to develop robust AI solutions for image understanding, synthetic data generation, visual inspection, and continuous model monitoring. The role will contribute to applied research and development of scalable AI capabilities spanning the full computer vision lifecycle—from data preparation and model development to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. The work will address practical challenges such as limited or imbalanced training data, rare events, changing image conditions, data drift, and model-performance degradation in operation. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced AI research and real-world deployment, translating novel Generative AI and computer vision methods into reliable and scalable solutions across a range of industrial and business applications. Roles & Responsibilities : Generative AI and Synthetic Data: Research, design, and implement Generative AI approaches for creating realistic and diverse synthetic image datasets. Explore diffusion models, generative adversarial networks, image-to-image generation, controllable generation, and related techniques to address limited data, rare defects, class imbalance, and long-tail inspection scenarios. · Computer Vision Model Development: Develop and evaluate deep learning models for industrial image inspection tasks such as image classification, defect detection, anomaly detection, object detection, segmentation, and representation learning. Work with CNN-based, transformer-based, and multimodal architectures. · Data-Efficient Learning: Investigate methods including transfer learning, self-supervised learning, few-shot learning, domain adaptation, active learning, and synthetic data augmentation to reduce annotation effort and improve model performance under limited-data conditions. · Model Monitoring and Robustness: Develop methods for continuously monitoring deployed inspection models and image-data pipelines. This includes detecting data drift, changes in image conditions, model-performance degradation, confidence shifts, unusual defect patterns, and out-of-distribution inputs. · Research and Experimentation: Formulate research hypotheses, design controlled experiments and ablation studies, establish appropriate evaluation benchmarks, and analyze results with scientific rigor. Compare state-of-the-art methods and identify approaches suitable for industrial deployment. · Prototype and Product Integration: Build proof-of-concept solutions and research prototypes using Python and modern deep learning frameworks. Collaborate with software, cloud, MLOps, manufacturing, and domain teams to integrate validated methods into scalable AI platforms and applications. · Scalable AI Lifecycle: Contribute to capabilities covering data preparation, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement across the complete computer vision model lifecycle. · Technology Transfer and Scientific Impact: Translate research outcomes into scalable and production-ready AI components. Document technical findings, communicate results to technical and business stakeholders, and contribute to publications, invention disclosures, patents, reusable frameworks, and Bosch’s intellectual-property portfolio. · Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with global research, engineering, manufacturing, and product teams to understand inspection requirements and convert real-world challenges into well-defined AI research and development problems. Educational qualification: Ph.D. or M.S. or M. description: Roles & Responsibilities : For this profile, the focus is set on numerical modeling and simulations for Multiphysics problems which are of great importance for proper long-term functioning of Bosch products. Further the candidate should have experience of working with git and have clarity on You will need to leverage your profound knowledge of numerical methods and algorithms for solving PDEs to solve 2D/3D multi-physics models using numerical techniques along with the requisite scripting and programming in python. Experience : 3+ Mandatory/requires Skills : Profound knowledge and experience of advanced numerical techniques like Finite element, Finite Volume and Finite difference methods, Discontinuous Galerkin method, Meshless methods, Arbitrary Lagrangian Eulerian methods for moving meshes. If you know only to use numerical methods via simulation tools like ANSYS, ABAQUs, COMSOL, OpenFOAM etc. and don’t have in depth knowledge of the theory behind the methods this is not a right role for you. what is CRED?
 
CRED is an exclusive community for india’s most trustworthy and creditworthy individuals, where the members are rewarded for good financial behavior.

title: Deployment Strategist
description: About the Team The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform. You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how." Role Description As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption. You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production. This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset. The impact you will have C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline. End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against. Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early. Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution. Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering. What we look for Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions. Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome. Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions. Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting. Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. title: SAP Functional SME
description: GAQ226R76 About Databricks At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business. We're looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them. In this role, you'll be the deep functional authority for your domain—translating how the business actually runs into standard, clean-core S/4HANA solutions, using process intelligence to find what's broken, and defining where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process . You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI, bridging Finance and Engineering to deliver a simpler, smarter, more automated experience. The Opportunity SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Functional SME, you'll own the functional blueprint for those processes—leading discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design, configuring S/4HANA, and defining the requirements for the intelligent, agentic layer that automates routine work and guides users through exceptions and approvals. You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules. Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale. What You'll Do Own Functional Design: Lead end-to-end process discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design for major finance processes (Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash), define S/4HANA solution scope, and design to standard, clean-core capabilities wherever possible. Configure S/4HANA: Own functional configuration, business rules, and master-data strategy for your domain, and partner with developers on extensions, APIs, and orchestration where standard functionality falls short. Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements. Shape the AI & Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements—task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants—and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer. Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI. Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features. Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements—cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption—and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives. Enable Adoption: Coach and upskill process owners and functional teams on process intelligence, best practices, and AI adoption, and drive readiness and change management for what you ship. What You Bring 6+ years of SAP functional consulting experience , with hands-on delivery across at least one full S/4HANA lifecycle and deep expertise in one or more finance domains—Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, or Order-to-Cash—plus working fluency in adjacent areas and in master-data governance. Process Intelligence: Demonstrated experience leading process discovery, process mapping, and process mining using SAP Process Intelligence or equivalent BPI tools, and translating mining outputs into solution requirements. Clean-Core Mindset: Strong bias toward standard, clean-core S/4HANA design, with sound judgment about when a requirement genuinely warrants an extension versus a change in process. AI & Agentic Automation: Practical experience applying Databricks AI and agentic capabilities to enterprise processes, with strong judgment on where AI can drive automation and decision support while maintaining appropriate governance, controls, auditability, and human oversight. Integration Awareness: Solid understanding of integration patterns (APIs/OData, IDoc, SAP Integration Suite / BTP) and the data requirements that feed process mining and AI models. Governance Rigor: Working knowledge of SAP authorizations, SoD, SOX and audit requirements, and the ability to design processes and automation that satisfy them. Stakeholder Leadership: Excellent workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and change-management skills, and the ability to present executive-level ROI and translate technical capability into measurable business value. Business-First Mindset: Pragmatic, outcome-driven approach to reducing process waste and risk, and comfort leading through ambiguity across complex business and IT landscapes. Preferred Qualifications SAP S/4HANA Associate or Professional certification for a relevant module, and SAP Activate methodology experience. Certification or training in SAP Process Intelligence, or experience with Celonis or other process mining vendors. Hands-on experience delivering at least one AI-assisted process improvement in production. Familiarity with the SAP AI and extension stack (BTP, AI Core, Joule) and a point of view on build-versus-adopt tradeoffs against a Databricks-native approach. Experience working alongside data teams to make ERP data usable for analytics and AI on modern data platforms (such as Databricks), and prior work in a high-growth technology company where ERP had to scale quickly. title: Copywriter
description:
About Fam (previously FamPay)

Fam is India’s first payments app for everyone above 11. FamApp helps make online and offline payments through UPI and FamCard. We are on a mission to raise a new, financially aware generation, and drive 250 million+ young users in India to kickstart their financial journey super early in their life.

We’re reimagining how the next generation experiences fintech—going beyond payments to build a lifestyle brand that blends money, identity, and everyday experiences into one seamless, intuitive journey.

Founded in 2019 by IIT Roorkee alumni, Fam is backed by some of the most respected investors around the world like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (Sequoia Capital) India, Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital and the likes of Kunal Shah, Amrish Rao as angel investors.


About this Role
You don't come across a company every day that obsesses over every word a user reads. At Fam, copy isn't an afterthought. It's a core part of the product and brand experience.
With a product built for teenagers, every word matters. From in-app nudges and push notifications to performance ads and social campaigns, the right copy can make experiences feel intuitive, trustworthy, and genuinely exciting.
We're looking for a sharp, versatile Copywriter who can own the written voice of Fam across surfaces. Someone equally comfortable writing a push notification that drives action as they are ideating a campaign concept or scripting a reel. You'll work closely with Product, Design, Growth, and Marketing teams to craft copy that's clear, on-brand, and built for a Gen-Z audience that has zero tolerance for boring.
If you can go from a blank doc to a finished brief fast, think in campaigns and copy simultaneously, and believe that a single sentence can make or break a user moment, you'll fit right in.

The Core Infrastructure team builds the platforms and systems that power everything at Fam, from real-time app experiences to high-volume payments. It operates as a small, high-leverage team with deep ownership. Every service at Fam runs on the platform this team builds, so it cares obsessively about system fundamentals, operational excellence, and mechanical sympathy.
What our systems process
1 Billion+ API requests per day powering ~10M daily transactions for 10M+ users at 20,000+ RPS.
470+ node Kubernetes cluster (~2,500 vCPUs and ~8 TiB RAM) under active orchestration.
Dynamic, multi-dimensional auto-scaling powered by 195+ HPAs paired with Karpenter.

While our core systems already handle massive scale, our next vision as a team is to turn infrastructure into a frictionless platform discipline.

We look to the CNCF landscape for best-in-class tools our systems, with a long-term commitment to contributing back to open source.

An overview of this role We're looking for an Intermediate Site Reliability Engineer to join the Cells Infrastructure team in GitLab's Scale & Architecture organization. In this role, you'll help build and operate Cells, the architecture that lets GitLab.com scale horizontally. Cells splits GitLab.com into many independent units, each with its own application and data stack, behind a shared routing layer. This is a build-it-and-run-it role. You'll provision cells, route traffic to them, deploy them safely, and keep them reliable in production. You'll also help move customer organizations onto Cells, one of GitLab's most important scaling initiatives. What you'll do Operate Cells in production: join the on-call rotation, respond to incidents, lead post-incident reviews, and drive corrective actions to completion. Define and monitor service level objectives (SLOs) for routing and cell health, and build the dashboards, alerts, and runbooks behind them. Provision and operate cell infrastructure on Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including Kubernetes, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), PostgreSQL, Redis, and object storage. Develop infrastructure as code with Terraform, Helm, and GitOps tooling such as Argo CD. Operate and extend the global routing layer, built on Cloudflare Workers, Envoy, and a Go service backed by Cloud Spanner, and expand routing to more protocols and services. Improve the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines behind ring-based deployments, covering promotion, database migrations, quality assurance validation, and rollback. Support organization migrations by preparing destination cells and helping with dry runs and production cutovers. Work with product teams to make their services cell-compatible, and write documentation so others can operate Cells with confidence. Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it. What you'll bring Professional experience running production infrastructure at scale on AWS, GCP, or both, including Kubernetes, along with strong Terraform and Helm skills. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in another systems language and willingness to work in Go daily. Solid grounding in site reliability engineering (SRE) best practices: SLOs and error budgets, blameless post-incident reviews, reducing toil through automation, capacity planning, and designing for graceful degradation. Experience owning services in production, including on-call, incident response, and monitoring with tools such as Prometheus and Grafana. Practical knowledge of progressive delivery: how to roll changes safely across a fleet and how to roll them back. A strong understanding of distributed-systems fundamentals, such as request routing, proxies, consistency, and failure domains. Experience working effectively in distributed, all-remote teams: you default to asynchronous, written-first communication, document decisions in issues and merge requests, hand off work cleanly across time zones, and stay transparent about progress and blockers. Experience with Cloudflare, Spanner, Argo CD, TypeScript, or operating GitLab at scale is a plus, not a requirement. A key research direction is to develop a model-agnostic external Recursive Reasoning Engine that enables smaller models (SLM/SSM/Hybrid etc.) to solve complex, repository-grounded software engineering tasks with greater effectiveness, traceability, and lower inference cost. Chakra: Building an autonomous AI interviewer that conducts, adapts to, and evaluates technical interviews end to end. Integrity: Detecting fraud and suspicious behavior across multiple signal types. The ways candidates game assessments change frequently, and the models need to keep up. Evaluation: Measuring technical skill in a world where AI writes the code. The old proxies no longer hold and the new ones have not been defined yet. Your focus will shift across these depending on where the highest-leverage work is at any given time. What you will do Research, Design, and Develop advanced Deep Learning models and novel Neural architectures. Explore architectures beyond Transformers, including State Space Models (SSMs), Liquid Neural Networks (LNNs), and Hybrid approaches. Design and implement Agentic AI systems, Recursive Reasoning Engines, and tool-augmented architectures. Fine-tuning of models using PEFT (e.g. LoRA, QLoRA etc.), and Knowledge Distillation Optimize model Performance, Inference Efficiency, Latency, and Memory utilization. Design rigorous experiments, evaluation frameworks, and benchmarks to validate research hypotheses. Translate cutting-edge research into scalable, production-grade AI systems. Strong foundations in Linear Algebra, Probability, Statistics, Optimization, and Deep Learning algorithms. Proficient in frameworks like PyTorch/JAX, with hands-on model development experience. Demonstrated ability to implement, reproduce, and extend research papers, including building neural architectures from scratch. Strong understanding of experimental design, model evaluation, benchmarking, and statistical validation. Demonstrated research aptitude through publications, open-source contributions etc. Even better if you have Understanding of Evaluation Benchmarks for S/W Engineering Tasks and Human-Agent Collaborations Familiarity with distributed computing, GPU acceleration, and scalable ML infrastructure. You will thrive here if you You enjoy solving open-ended research problems and challenging established assumptions. You prefer first-principles thinking and rigorous experimentation over simply applying existing models. You are excited to explore next-generation AI architectures beyond traditional Transformers. You thrive in a fast-paced environment with intellectual freedom, ownership, and direct collaboration with leadership. This role is a strong fit for data engineers with 2 to 4 years of experience who want to take their technical depth into a customer-facing role. If you have spent the last few years building pipelines, working with cloud warehouses, and solving real data problems, but you are starting to wonder what comes next, this is worth a closer look.

In this role, you will work directly with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs at companies evaluating Hevo across the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, and ANZ. You will help them design the right data architecture, walk them through trade-offs, and earn the technical trust that turns an evaluation into a partnership. You need to walk into a Zoom with a VP of Data Engineering at a US fintech or a Head of Analytics at a European e-commerce company, earn their technical respect in the first five minutes, and hold it for the rest of the engagement.

The technical depth you have built does not go away. It gets applied to a much wider set of problems, a much larger audience, and a global stage.

Hevo runs real-time data pipelines from 150+ sources into modern warehouses for over 1,000 companies, including DoorDash and Shopify. You will be the person customers rely on to make sure Hevo fits their stack, their scale, and their goals.


Why this role is worth considering

In your current role, you build what is specified. In this role, you sit with senior data leaders and help them decide what to build across the modern data stack. Your existing experience in CDC, warehouse design, and pipeline reliability becomes the foundation for higher-leverage work.

You will be in regular technical conversations with Heads of Data and CTOs at fast-growing companies across North America, Europe, and beyond. You will run discovery, defend architecture choices, and present in rooms where decisions get made. This is rare exposure for someone at the 2 to 4 year mark, and almost unheard of from Bangalore.

Strong performers in this role grow into senior individual contributor roles, lead the function, or move into product, customer success leadership, or founding-engineer roles at their next company. The optionality this role builds is significant.

Run technical discovery calls with Heads of Data, Data Engineering Managers, and CTOs to understand their stack, pain points, and constraints. These are global conversation

title: Strategy & Ops (Founder's Office)
description:
Read this part first
Experience: 2 to 8 years
Location: HSR Layout, BLR
Most Strategy and Operations roles quietly turn into reporting jobs. You pull the numbers, format the decks, and remind people about deadlines. This is not that role.
This is the role for someone who wants to learn, at close range, how a fast growing company actually plans, prioritizes, and executes. You will work directly with the CEO and the leadership team on the problems that cut across functions, the ones no single team can solve alone. Your job is to turn ambiguity into a plan, and a plan into results.
For the right person, this also happens to be one of the best leadership educations available anywhere. People who do this job well at Hevo build the instincts of a real operator, and many go on to run things. But the simplest reason to take it is this: you get to work on what matters most, alongside the people who decide it.
What you will own:
1. The operational rhythm of the whole company. You will work with the CEO to keep the entire machine moving across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Engineering, HR, Solutions, and Support. You will run the OKR process with the leadership team, drive quarterly planning and goal setting, and track delivery so nothing important slips. You will be the person who can tell, on any given day, how healthy the organization really is and where attention is needed next.
2. The strategic projects that move the needle. You will partner with the CEO and other leaders to spot the initiatives that genuinely change the trajectory of the business, then own them end to end until they are big enough to stand on their own and get handed to a dedicated team. These are the bets that matter most, and you will be trusted to carry them.
3. Cross functional execution and alignment. You will be the connective tissue across functions, driving communication so the company moves as one. You will be a real thought partner to leadership on vision, priorities, and the hard tradeoffs. You will manage relationships with stakeholders inside and outside the company, and when needed, represent leadership in reviews.

To learn more, visit glance.com. Overview of the role: We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to join our algorithmic and research science team. You'll work on mathematically rigorous, research-driven problems at production scale, while owning problems end to end. This role sits at the intersection of theory and application, designing algorithms that combine elegant modeling with measurable business impact. Specifically, our scientists tackle challenges across traffic shaping, fraud detection, ad quality, pricing strategies, and auction theory, along with their practical applications. We leverage the latest deep learning models alongside classical machine learning techniques to build innovative solutions. As the heart of the InMobi Exchange, our team optimizes the company's core business functions and creates the strategic moat that sets us apart in the market. As an Applied Scientist, you will not just "use models"—you will formulate them, evaluate their assumptions, tailor them to our problem domain, and bring them to life in production. Many of our challenges have no off-the-shelf solutions; we require scientific creativity to bridge research and reality. If you thrive on solving complex, high-impact problems and want to see your ideas shape the future of a global exchange, this is the place where your work will truly make a difference. The impact you'll make: Formulate, analyze, and implement algorithms that power real-time auctions, dynamic pricing, bid shaping, pacing, and traffic allocation across a massive-scale ad marketplace. Design and experiment with methods in online learning, reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, forecasting, game theory, and Bayesian modeling—in non-stationary, adversarial environments. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy your models in production and run real-world experiments with rapid feedback loops (measured in hours, not weeks). Participate in scientific design reviews and contribute to raising the methodological bar of the team. Contribute to the scientific community by publishing high-quality research, conducting internal seminars, and staying abreast of advances in machine learning, algorithms, and applied statistics. Evaluate the long-term dynamics of deployed algorithms, incorporating feedback, exploitation-exploration trade-offs, and incentives within multi-agent systems. Help identify new areas for innovation by translating business challenges into research questions and proposing novel, high-impact methodologies. Translate mathematical ideas into practical, high-performance algorithms that operate at scale in production environments. Explore and close the loop between model predictions and real-world outcomes, refining algorithms based on system behavior. The experience we need: A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline is strongly preferred. title: AM/M - Risk Analytics - User Lending
description:
About the Team
Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here's your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit, built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys. Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of a 10-100-1000 journey, and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
About the Role
Meesho FS runs two lines of business: SME Lending, which offers Business Loans, and User Lending, which offers BNPL and Personal Loans (PL). 
User Lending is now our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey. We have 274Mn ATU, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale - our being a captive audience means both Growth and Risk are an outcome of underwriting, which is owned by the Risk team.
Herein also lies one of our biggest challenges: how do we assess the risk of borrowers without any credit history or income data? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
This person will be responsible for driving the analytics behind these questions for User Lending - creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and recommending policy decisions, across a well-established BNPL portfolio and a Personal Loans portfolio that is still scaling.
Your role will focus on:
Owning the risk for one or more segments of the portfolio while maintaining a healthy growth.
Analyzing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, SMS data, and other alternate data.
Creating policies, scorecards and models (Application Score, B-Score, Collection Scores) for BNPL and PL.
Designing experiments to test cohort behaviour, experimental policies, and new opportunities for growth.
Identifying pockets of risk within the portfolio that don't make sense, and identifying leading indicators / EWS.
Automating reporting and tracking of the portfolio at multiple levels - Ops performance measures, key performance indicators, and their drivers.
Refining credit policies based on data and creating new policies for unexplored segments, including building day-1 policies for Personal Loans as the product scales.
Configuring and testing rules in the real-time Business Rule Engine (BRE), and working with the Bureau Feature Store to define new underwriting features.

title: Data Scientist III (Team- Valmo)
description:
About us
Meesho - Every story here begins with a spark of ambition and a touch of entrepreneurial magic. We're not just a platform — we're your partner in transforming dreams into reality.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping costs, growing their business by tapping the company's massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and our in-house logistics arm Valmo, in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers.
Affordable, relatable merchandise mirroring local markets has helped us make inroads with first-time internet users in the country. We cater to an underserved and unique customer base and cover every serviceable pincode in the country. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have enabled us to become the first Indian horizontal e-commerce company.
Know more about Meesho here: https://www.meesho.io/
About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.

title: AI Product Engineer
description:
Role Overview
We are transitioning our organization to an AI-first operational model. We are seeking an AI Product Engineer to architect and build the company’s central intelligence engine.
In this role, you will be the primary builder of automated intelligence systems—tools that not only retrieve insights but actively trigger workflows, and synthesize strategic intel across our entire business landscape.
Role Profile
This is a high-impact, hands-on engineering role requiring a convergence of three distinct skill sets:
Software Engineering (50%): Building scalable middleware, API integrations, and production-grade applications that connect our data stack to business tools (CRM, Marketing Automation, Support/Ticketing).
AI Engineering (30%): Implementing Agentic workflows, RAG architectures, and LLMs to process unstructured data at scale.
Data Analytics (20%): Leveraging SQL and B2B SaaS metrics to ensure all automation is grounded in accurate, governed data.
Key Responsibilities
1. Building the "Enterprise Brain" (Architecture & Integration)
Develop a unified intelligence layer that ingests signals from disparate sources (Product Telemetry, CRM, Call Transcripts, Marketing inputs) and processes them into actionable outputs.
Build robust integrations/webhooks to push AI-generated insights directly into workflow tools (e.g., pushing "Churn Risk" alerts into Salesforce
2. AI Logic & Agent Implementation
Architect "Agentic" workflows where LLMs are granted permission to perform tasks 
Implement advanced RAG to ground AI outputs in company documentation, historical data, and strategic context.
Ensure rigorous evaluation and guardrails for non-deterministic models to prevent "hallucinations" in critical business workflows.
3. Data Engineering & Governance
Collaborate with Analytics Engineers to ensure the underlying data pipelines support real-time or near-real-time AI applications.
Maintain security and privacy standards, ensuring that AI agents respect data access permissions across different departments.
Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications:
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
Software Engineering: 3+ years of experience in Python development, with strong proficiency in API development (FastAPI/Django) and building integrations between SaaS platforms.
AI/ML Application: Proven experience building applications using LLM APIs and orchestration frameworks, Experience with "Agent" concepts.
Data Proficiency: Strong SQL skills and familiarity with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake/BigQuery).
Preferred Qualifications:
Business Systems Knowledge: Experience working with APIs for major B2B tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, Marketo).
Workflow Automation: Experience with tools like Airflow, Zapier/Make (advanced usage), or custom workflow engines.
B2B Domain Expertise: Understanding of the interplay between Sales, Product, and Customer Success.
Competencies
The "Builder" Mindset: You are

description: As a Product Owner at NIQ Brandbank, you will be responsible for a range of customer-facing and internal products that drive our Content creation solutions. You will translate product strategy and business priorities into clear development requirements, leading the delivery and implementation of changes across our customer platforms and internal systems to support operational processes, customer needs and continuous improvement. This role involves executing the technical development roadmap in line with the product vision, strategy and business priorities. You will use internal stakeholder feedback, user needs and operational insight to improve our platforms, enhance operational effectiveness and deliver value across the business. As Product Owner, the role is responsible for defining release plans, managing and prioritising the product backlog, and working closely with development teams and stakeholders to support successful delivery, product launches and continuous improvement. This includes creating and managing user stories through Jira, defining clear acceptance criteria, supporting sprint planning and coordinating product and project delivery activities. Responsible for the end-to-end product development and project delivery process, including release planning, delivery expectations and the successful launch of new functionality. Provide product vision and direction to Agile development teams and stakeholders, translating customer and business needs into clear requirements. Plan, prioritise and maintain the product backlog, assessing business value and ROI to ensure stories, epics and themes align with product strategy and business objectives. Manage backlog refinement and iteration planning, creating well-defined user stories in Jira with clear requirements, dependencies, expected outcomes and acceptance criteria. Define sprint goals and coordinate releases and upgrades in collaboration with Product Management, development, testing and project delivery teams. Work with other Product Managers and Product Owners to align strategy, priorities and dependencies across products, ensuring coordinated delivery. Apply a Voice of Customer, user feedback and product insights to inform the roadmap, development priorities and continuous improvement. description: About the team: The CPQ & NPI Operations team sits within Product Operations and is at the core of how we bring new products to market and optimise our quote-to-cash process. We don’t just operationalise new SKUs—we ensure seamless integration of next-generation quoting tools, drive automation, and enhance the overall sales experience. We partner across Product, Engineering, Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance to streamline how products are configured, quoted, sold, and provisioned. Our team ensures that our CPQ and Product Master tools remain high-performing, scalable systems—balancing automation, policy enforcement, and ease of use without overloading it with unnecessary complexity. About the role: We are seeking a highly driven, enterprising individual with exceptional communication skills to join our NPI Operations team and help operationalise our products in our quote-to-cash processes. In this full-time hybrid role, you’ll use your NPI and CPQ knowledge to translate strategy into operational reality: aligning with cross-functional partners on process and policy, compiling requirements, and delivering efficient, scalable solutions from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End of Life (EOL). What you'll do: Support GTM initiatives and new product launches; be accountable for CPQ and NPI deliverables that drive product growth and improve sales productivity. Own the NPI Operations ticket queue and dashboards: triage, assign, track, and follow up to meet SLAs and prevent escalations; balance day-to-day support with small to medium projects. Deliver NPI releases and bug fixes based on priority; execute predefined processes independently and escalate for support or visibility when appropriate. Work across the full quote-to-cash lifecycle—from packaging, pricing, and selling to growth, retention, and EOL transitions—to drive cross-functional alignment. title: Database Reliability Engineer/Database Engineer (Rubrik Security Cloud Platform)
description: About the Role We are seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our end-to-end database infrastructure. You will manage both our low-latency transactional engines and our real-time analytical/lakehouse storage systems. You will bridge systems engineering, database internals, and automation to maintain rock-solid data integrity, low query latency, and high availability across the entire data lifecycle. What you'll do Performance & Query Optimization: Diagnose and resolve latency regressions, lock/latch contention, index strategies, and memory/disk bottlenecks across both row-oriented and columnar engines. Disaster Recovery & Data Integrity: Ensure strict RTO/RPO adherence, automated backup validation, PITR (point-in-time recovery), and data consistency across transactional and analytical stores. Storage Optimization & Compaction: Manage compaction policies, partition strategies, file sizing, and storage tiering to minimize storage costs and read amplification. Transactional Reliability & Operations: Manage HA, automated failover, replication topology, and zero-downtime maintenance for production RDBMS clusters. Analytical Storage Infrastructure: Maintain, scale, and optimize real-time analytical engines (ClickHouse) and lakehouse formats/engines (Apache Iceberg, BigQuery). Infrastructure as Code & Observability: Build declarative automation for cluster provisioning, schema migrations, and metric alerting (Prometheus, PromQL, Grafana) Experience you'll need Database Internals & RDBMS Fundamentals: Deep understanding of ACID guarantees, WAL, checkpointing, and recovery mechanics (e.g., ARIES-style recovery). Comprehensive grasp of concurrency control, transaction isolation levels, lock protocols (2PL, deadlocks), and MVCC architectures. Deep knowledge of storage structures: B+ Trees, LSM-Trees, and columnar storage layouts (e.g., Parquet, ORC, ClickHouse Wide/Compact formats). Operational Database Experience: 4+ years running production database infrastructure, with deep expertise in [PostgreSQL / MySQL]. Experience optimizing and managing cost/quotas in Google Cloud BigQuery (partitioning, clustering, reservation slots). Experience with OLAP DB like: ClickHouse, BQ Systems & Kernel Engineering: Strong Linux fundamentals: I/O subsystems, page cache vs. engine buffer pools, disk alignment, asynchronous I/O, and memory management. Automation & Software Engineering: Using Python or Go for building database automation, operators, and CLI tooling. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and container orchestration. Preferred skills and qualifications Hands-on administration and performance tuning of ClickHouse (cluster topologies, ZooKeeper/Keeper coordination, MergeTree engine family, mutations, and compaction). Experience with change data capture (CDC) pipelines (e.g., Debezium, Kafka) feeding transactional updates into ClickHouse/Iceberg. Experience managing lakehouse storage patterns using Apache Iceberg (metadata management, snapshot expiration, file compaction/orphan cleanup). Experience with automated schema migration tools (e.g., gh-ost, Liquibase, Bytebase). title: Legal Counsel
description: Legal Counsel, Channels Bangalore, India preferred (Hybrid in office 2 days a week) | Open to fully remote within India for the right candidate About Our Team The Rubrik Commercial Legal Team manages Rubrik's global commercial contracts and revenue-related legal matters. Within Commercial Legal, the Channels & Alliances legal team supports Rubrik's partner ecosystem: the distributors, resellers, managed service providers, global and regional system integrators, and alliance partners through which Rubrik sells its data security and cyber resilience products worldwide. Rubrik goes to market primarily through a two-tier channel: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, the Distributor sells to a Reseller, and the Reseller sells to the end Customer. This role is the day-to-day legal partner for that business unit. You will be the first point of contact for the Channels organization on reseller and distributor agreements, amendments and partner program requests, keeping deals moving and partners compliant. You will join a small, collaborative team and work alongside a Channels Legal Counsel peer, reporting to the Director of Legal who leads Channels & Alliances, Marketplaces and Inbound Licensing. This is a hands-on role for an attorney who already works in the channel world, enjoys negotiating with partners and wants to be a trusted advisor to a fast-moving sales organization. Where You Can Make an Impact Own day-to-day channel contracting: Draft, review and negotiate reseller agreements, distributor agreements, amendments, adoption agreements for partner affiliates, resale enablement amendments and other documents partners need to resell Rubrik's SaaS and subscription products. Live in the two-tier channel model: Apply a deep working knowledge of Rubrik's go-to-market: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, who sells to a Reseller, who sells to the end Customer. Understand how order flow, pricing and discounts, deal registration, flow-down terms and end-user agreements work across each tier, and spot when a request breaks the model. Be the front door for the Channels organization: Manage the channel contract-request intake queue. Triage, prioritize and route incoming requests, resolve routine matters yourself and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation. Support the Partner Program: Advise Partner Programs and Partner Operations on partner program requests, program terms and conditions, tier and status changes, program exceptions, incentive and referral arrangements, and partner onboarding and offboarding. Advise channel leaders and account managers: Act as a trusted advisor to Channel Account Managers, Distribution leaders, Alliances and the Channels Global Partner Organization. Answer their questions with practical, business-ready guidance and help them close deals on standard terms. Negotiate directly with partners: Lead negotiations and calls with partner legal, procurement and business teams. Hold Rubrik's standard positions, use approved fallbacks and know when to escalate. Build and maintain templates and playbooks: Create and update channel agreement templates, amendment forms, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, FAQs and training so the ecosystem stays on standard terms and the business can self-serve. Drive deals to signature: Coordinate internal approvals, signature requests and e-signature execution, and work with Partner Operations and Deal Desk so executed agreements are recorded correctly in Salesforce and partners can transact. Apply a compliance and competition lens: Identify and escalate antitrust and competition law issues common to distribution (resale price maintenance, dual distribution, territorial and customer restrictions, exclusivity), as well as anti-corruption, sanctions and export, and public-sector procurement issues. Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Commercial Legal, Privacy, Security, Revenue, Tax, Deal Desk and Partner Operations to deliver consistent answers and keep channel terms aligned with Rubrik's customer-facing terms. Support a global channel: Work IST business hours while supporting partners and stakeholders worldwide, with a primary focus on APAC and EMEA and meaningful AMER coverage. Flex your hours during quarter-end and other peak periods to support AMER deals. Improve how we work: Spot repeat questions and bottlenecks, propose process and template fixes, and use technology (including AI tools) to speed up routine work. Ideal Background Licensed attorney in India (LL.B. and enrolled with a State Bar Council) with 3 to 6 years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house experience at a technology or SaaS company. Currently working in a channel, partner or distribution contracting role. You negotiate reseller and distributor agreements today and understand two-tier distribution and how SaaS is resold through partners. Comfortable negotiating directly with partner legal and procurement teams and advising business stakeholders without a safety net. Working knowledge of partner programs, deal registration, subscription and SaaS commercial models, and how channel terms interact with end-customer terms. Awareness of competition and compliance issues in distribution relationships and of anti-bribery and anti-corruption rules that apply to selling through partners. Excellent English drafting and communication skills. You write clearly, explain risk in business terms and give a recommendation, not a menu. Organized and reliable in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You prioritize well, track your queue and close the loop. Independent, proactive and business-oriented, with sound judgment about what to decide and what to escalate. Experience with Salesforce, DocuSign or similar e-signature tools, and contract lifecycle management systems is a plus. Willingness to flex working hours periodically to support AMER-based deals and quarter-end activity. description: Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience About the Team & Role The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges. The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable. We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements. title: Software Engineer
description: Location : Pune About Team & About Role: As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org. You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains. We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team. Responsibilities Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems. Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions. Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought. Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic. Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly. Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed. Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET. Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.). Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature. Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status. Requirements Must-have Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang . Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes. Working knowledge of Active Directory . Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS . Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work. Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency. Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts. Simple, effective written and verbal communication. Nice-to-have Directory internals (schema, bind operations). HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection). Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI). Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines. Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app). title: Agent Engineer
description:
The distance between an AI system that works and one that millions of people rely on every day is where the real engineering lives. Crossing it is what Agent Engineers at Sarvam do.

The agents you build go into live operation at India's largest banks, insurers, NBFCs and government departments, and at some of the country's fastest-growing companies, handling millions of real interactions, measured against outcomes the customer wants to drive.

The hard part is not the first version. It is everything after: mapping the full space of what an agent has to handle so the scenarios that matter are covered by design rather than discovered in production, engineering for the failure modes instead of the happy path, and building the evals and instrumentation that make quality measurable, so drift surfaces in the data rather than in a customer escalation.

We treat agents as code. Not prompts someone tweaks in a console, but engineered artifacts: versioned, reviewed, and held to a regression suite, where you can reason about what a change will do and roll it back if you are wrong. Anyone who has watched an AI system quietly decay because nobody could tell which change broke it understands why this matters.

And then doing it again for the next customer, faster, because you built the first one to be repeatable.


ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

Production, at real scale

Not prototypes, not demos. Systems in live operation at some of India's largest institutions, carrying real volume, measured against outcomes the customer has signed up to. You will see the consequences of your engineering decisions within days.

You work at the source

Sarvam builds the whole stack: the foundational models, the infrastructure they run on, and the products on top of them. You are in a room with the people who built it. Anyone who has delivered AI on top of someone else's black box knows how much difference that makes.

A genuinely broad surface

Sarvam's products span conversational AI, agentic workflows, intelligent document processing, and content, including dubbing and document translation. You will own a motion and go deep in it, and the depth you build travels well as products mature and new ones ship.

 - Partner with ML and platform teams to keep large runs alive and serving latency predictable.

Sarvam’s brand is already an argument about motion — it just hasn’t been allowed to move yet.

The monogram is a gateway that emerges — layered circles resolving out of mandala geometry into a single threshold form. The palette isn’t a set of swatches; it’s a continuous run from blue to orange, built to suggest progression and responsive state. Both of those ideas are about change over time. Both are currently being made mostly in stills.

We want the person who resolves that. Not someone to animate a logo once for a launch, but someone who decides how this brand behaves — how it enters, how it responds, how a gradient moves without becoming wallpaper — and then builds that language across films, web and product.

It’s a rare brief: a real identity with real motion logic baked into it, and nobody has run at it yet.

This role builds the platform that sits on top of that fleet - the scheduling, scaling, multi-tenancy, serving, and self-service layers that let our ML teams use thousands of GPUs without a human in the loop for every job.

This is the build side of infrastructure, not the operate side. Our SREs keep the fleet reliable and carry the pager; you build the systems that make the fleet usable - and that make it break less in the first place.  - 3+ years (SDE 2) or 5+ years (SDE 3) building and running production backend services.

The CPU Infrastructure team runs everything outside the GPU fleet: Kubernetes across Azure, AWS, GCP and Indian sovereign clouds, the network between them, Cloudflare, identity, secrets, observability, cost and the delivery pipeline every product ships through.

About the role

You are an infrastructure engineer whose first instinct is security, and who builds rather than only operates. You have worked on banking, fintech, payments or similarly regulated products, where a misconfiguration is an incident and an audit is routine. Here you set what “secure” means across Sarvam’s infrastructure and build the automation that enforces it, so security is a property of the pipeline rather than a review step. title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.



ABOUT SARVAM

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.



WHAT THIS ROLE PROMISES YOU

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.

 - Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.

 - Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.

 - Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.

 - Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.

 - Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.

 - Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.

 - Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

title: Software Engineer - Model API Platform
description:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC and LIC.


About the role

Sarvam's model APIs (ASR, TTS, Vision, LLM, Translate) are how developers and enterprises ship products on our foundation models. The platform handles tens of millions of API calls every day, over HTTP and WebSockets, with metering, billing, prepaid wallets and rate-limiting all part of the same stack.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to own major parts of this platform end to end, working closely with the Staff Engineer who leads its architecture. You will take an area such as speech to text pipeline,or text to speech pipeline, and be accountable for its reliability, performance and end-to-end latencies. This role is for someone who is obsessed with latencies, optimizes services and network paths to shave off milliseconds, ships fast, reasons from first principles, and treats AI as the default way to get engineering work done.


What you will do


Own a platform area end to end

• Own one or more major parts of the platform, such as the WebSocket streaming layer, a speech recognition pipeline, or text to speech pipeline: build, operate and improve them.

• Turn loosely defined goals into RFCs, milestones and shipped results, and write down the decisions and trade-offs.

• Be accountable after launch: on-call, incident response, root-cause analysis and follow-through on fixes.

• Make the call when a decision is needed, and own the outcome.

• Obsessed with latencies, dissecting existing services to understand the system, and tuning the right knobs to optimize performance.

• Bring services across without regressions in customer-facing APIs, latency or reliability.


Build real-time and model-serving pipelines

• Build and operate streaming infrastructure: WebSocket connections, long-lived sessions queue-based batch processing, backpressure and low-latency model invocation.

• Engineer audio pipelines: TTS chunking around model context limits, sample-rate conversion and format encoding, and VAD-based silence detection for ASR.

• Hold your services to sub-100ms latency SLOs in a multi-tenant environment, and know where every millisecond goes.


Think in systems and from first principles

• Reasons from constraints: latency budgets per hop, throughput, cost per request, failure modes and tenant isolation.

• Use back-of-the-envelope estimates to decide what to build, what to optimize and what to leave alone.

• Prefer simple designs you can fully explain over clever ones you cannot.

• Build in observability from day one: logging, metrics and tracing

title: Business Development Representative
description: We’re looking for a motivated, and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join ServiceNow’s Global Business Acceleration team. As a BDR, you’ll play a critical role in driving pipeline growth by identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers. Through strategic outreach, inbound lead follow-up and engagement with prospects from marketing campaigns, you’ll help connect organizations with solutions that address their business challenges. In this role, you’ll engage prospective customers, uncover business needs, assess interest using established qualification criteria, and collaborate with Account Executives to advance qualified opportunities. You’ll develop foundational skills in communication, prospecting, and relationship building. Whether you're launching your career or bringing experience from another industry, GBA is more than your first role at ServiceNow. It's an opportunity to discover your potential, accelerate your growth, and build a career with a company shaping the future of work. What you get to do in this role: Generate new business pipeline through a combination of outbound prospecting, inbound lead qualification, and follow-up on marketing campaigns and events. Engage current and prospective customers through phone, email, and social—and connect with key contacts using approved messaging and defined qualification criteria. Take ownership of individual performance goals, embrace coaching and feedback, and contribute to a collaborative, high-performing sales culture. What you gain from this role: An immersive four-week new hire training program designed to build your sales skills, confidence, and knowledge of the ServiceNow platform. A collaborative global community that celebrates successes, encourages innovation, and invests in your future. A strong foundation in technology sales, with real-world experience and ongoing development opportunities to help shape your career at ServiceNow. To be successful in this role you have: High school diploma or GED equivalent required Strong verbal and written communication skills and the ability to engage professionally and confidently with customers and internal stakeholders. Demonstrate initiative, curiosity, and a results-oriented mindset, with a willingness to take ownership of goals and responsibilities. Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. Resilience, adaptability, and growth mindset. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities. title: Executive Assistant
description: Executive Assistant Role Summary We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to provide high-level administrative, operational, and strategic support to executive leadership. In this role, you will act as a primary point of contact and trusted liaison between executives and internal/external stakeholders, ensuring seamless business operations, effective calendar and travel management, and flawless execution of key operational priorities. Key Responsibilities Calendar & Meeting Management: Manage complex executive calendars, resolve scheduling conflicts proactively, prepare agendas, compile background documentation, and record key action items. Travel & Logistics: Coordinate end-to-end domestic and international travel logistics, including flights, accommodations, visas, and detailed itineraries; oversee timely submission of expense reports. Executive Communication: Draft, proofread, and format professional correspondence, presentations, and executive summaries for internal and external stakeholders. Banking & Financial Operations: Oversee personal and official banking transactions, investment administration, and confidential financial record-keeping in collaboration with wealth management and banking partners. Confidentiality & Information Governance: Handle sensitive organizational, legal, and financial documents with complete discretion and strict confidentiality. Project & Operational Coordination: Assist in driving cross-functional special projects, track deliverables across teams, and ensure prompt completion of executive priorities. Ad-Hoc Support: Provide comprehensive support for personal administrative tasks and executive coordination to maximize leadership efficiency. Qualifications & Requirements Experience: 3+ years of proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Executive Coordinator, or in a similar support role at fast-paced technology firms. Technical Proficiency: High proficiency in Google Workspace / MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook) and modern productivity tools. Soft Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, superior organizational abilities, strong multitasking capability under tight deadlines, and high emotional intelligence. Integrity: Demonstrated track record of sound judgment, diplomatic communication, and utmost discretion when managing high-level confidential information. Work Schedule & Shift Details Working Hours: US Shift alignment to effectively support global leadership and international business operations. Testing Proficiency in unit, integration, and component testing using Jest, React Testing Library, and PyTest. Entrepreneurial & Agile Thrives in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, displaying high ownership, adaptability, and resilience. Architecture & APIs Exposure to GraphQL, microservices architecture, and event-driven patterns (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ). Cloud & DevOps Hands-on experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
